verdict.rationale: The pack holds verbatim guidance text pulled from several canada.ca IRCC pages (work permits, Start-up Visa, processing times, home page), and one item describes the processing-time tool as public. That implies the public reading surface returned real content rather than a bot wall or empty JS shell. No item explicitly documents fetching by an identified, keyless agent user agent, or the absence of CAPTCHA or bot filtering. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a fetch with an identified agent user agent, confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot wall, confirmation that content is server-rendered rather than JS-dependent, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
